dedupe_keys.name: toronto fire ambulance and police facility locations

description: City of Toronto publishes three point layers of emergency facilities: all active fire stations and fire-related facilities (latitude and longitude), the ambulance stations and district offices (with address point identifier, name and coordinates), and the police facilities; the ambulance page notes that ambulance stations are not the origin point for most dispatches. Coverage: the City of Toronto; each portal record says updates "as available", last modified 2026-02-20 for fire and police and 2026-07-29 for ambulance. Format and access: GeoJSON, GeoPackage, CSV, Shapefile, downloadable without registration from the City of Toronto Open Data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Open Government Licence - Toronto, as shown on the dataset page (the CKAN API licence field reads "License not specified"); cost: free. Caveats: the layers are locations only, without staffing, apparatus or response areas; the CKAN API licence field does not carry the Open Government Licence - Toronto shown on the pages; the files were not opened; the record is anchored to the fire facility page and links the other two. Simulation uses: emergency-service coverage and response-time models, critical-facility exposure in flood and outage studies, and station siting analysis. Related catalogue records: Urban Form Toronto: built environment and walkability measures on a 100 m hexagon grid (data-toronto-urban-form-hex-measures); City of Toronto watermain breaks 1990 to 2016 (data-toronto-watermain-breaks); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
